findings: GDK_DEBUG=gl-gles is absent from GTK4.18.6 debug keys; GDK_DISABLE=gl-api blocks desktop GL while leaving GLES enabled.
GDK_DISABLE=glx blocks the GLX fallback; GDK_DISABLE=vulkan keeps this validation on the OpenGL/GLES renderer.
GSK_RENDERER=gl remains an alias but emits an old-renderer removal warning; opengl and ngl map directly to GSK_TYPE_GL_RENDERER.
GSK_RENDERER is a preferred renderer, not a no-fallback guarantee: GSK can still fall back to Cairo.
EGL context creation prefers GLES unless GL_PREFER_GL is set or a shared context requires another allowed API.
acceptance: New standalone GTK process so an existing application or D-Bus activation does not absorb the request with its old environment
GDK OpenGL diagnostics report an EGL context with es:yes and PowerVR identity
GSK diagnostics report GskGLRenderer, not GskCairoRenderer
Process maps, render-node use and GPU error counters corroborate the log; process liveness alone is insufficient
